integrity: All 11 types and the 720 labelled permutations were exhaustively verified with standalone integer/permutation code. The proof independently identifies the geometric objects and derives the fixed-point formulas. Historical priority and independent mathematical validation remain open.
scientific_limitations: Only smooth six-point blowup cubic surfaces over finite fields of characteristic at least five. The partition table does not assert realization of each type over every field; the full W(E6) action is not classified. Earlier general class-function methods may imply portions of the finite tabulation; no exhaustive historical priority claim is made.
title: Frobenius orbit spectra of cubic-surface tritangent flags for a six-point blowup
